text.hi: किताब कहती है: ‘rainbow’ पर एक पैराग्राफ़ लिखो। चलो एक-एक वाक्य बनाते हैं।
text.hinglish: Kitaab kehti hai: ‘rainbow’ par ek paragraph likho. Chalo ek-ek vaakya banaate hain.
text.en: The book says: write a paragraph on ‘rainbow’. Let's build it one sentence at a time.

prompt.en: Say that a rainbow is very beautiful.

prompt.hi: यह बारिश के मौसम में आसमान में दिखता है।
prompt.hinglish: Yeh baarish ke mausam mein aasmaan mein dikhta hai.
prompt.en: Say where and when we see it.

steps.answer: We see it in the sky in the rainy season.

meaning.hi: हम इसे बारिश के मौसम में आसमान में देखते हैं।
meaning.hinglish: Hum ise baarish ke mausam mein aasmaan mein dekhte hain.

prompt.hi: यह बादलों के बीच एक सुंदर पुल जैसा लगता है।
prompt.hinglish: Yeh baadalon ke beech ek sundar pul jaisa lagta hai.
prompt.en: Say what it looks like among the clouds.

steps.answer: It looks like a pretty bridge in the clouds.

meaning.hi: यह बादलों में एक सुंदर पुल जैसा लगता है।
meaning.hinglish: Yeh baadalon mein ek sundar pul jaisa lagta hai.

prompt.hi: इंद्रधनुष में सात रंग होते हैं।
prompt.hinglish: Indradhanush mein saat rang hote hain.
prompt.en: Say how many colours it has.

meaning.hi: इंद्रधनुष में सात रंग होते हैं।
meaning.hinglish: Indradhanush mein saat rang hote hain.

text.hi: पूरा पैराग्राफ़ अपनी कॉपी में ऐसे लिखो: A rainbow is very beautiful. We see it in the sky in the rainy season. It comes when the sun shines after the rain. It looks like a pretty bridge in the clouds. A rainbow has seven colours: violet, indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange and red.
text.hinglish: Poora paragraph apni copy mein aise likho: A rainbow is very beautiful. We see it in the sky in the rainy season. It comes when the sun shines after the rain. It looks like a pretty bridge in the clouds. A rainbow has seven colours: violet, indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange and red.
text.en: Write the whole paragraph in your notebook: A rainbow is very beautiful. We see it in the sky in the rainy season. It comes when the sun shines after the rain. It looks like a pretty bridge in the clouds. A rainbow has seven colours: violet, indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange and red.
